scope: Bolivia medical discovery — Universidad Mayor de San Simón Faculty of Medicine

verifiedFacts.claim: UMSS publishes a 2026 Licenciatura en Medicina plan in its academic system; the plan includes first-year Medicina Social, Anatomía Humana, Histología, and Embriología y Genética.

UMSS states that the rotating internship is Medicine's sole graduation modality, lasts one calendar year, and includes rotations in internal medicine, surgery, paediatrics, gynaecology-obstetrics and social medicine.
UMSS's Medicine page identifies supervised clinical placements for the internship in public and social-security hospitals at second and third levels of care.
UMSS's Faculty of Medicine reports that the Medicine programme worked toward its fifth international accreditation through ARCU-SUR of MERCOSUR.
UMSS's Faculty of Medicine lists student medical insurance, scholarships and a psychopedagogical support centre for enrolled Medicine students.

holdReasons: No current official undergraduate fee/cost publication was assembled for the required payload fields.
A current, complete entry-admissions and instructional-language evidence set remains incomplete for publication.
